SMART Base is built like any IG on the FHIR IG layer, with two WHO steps
added. This page gives the commands for **this** repository,
[litlfred/smart-base](https://github.com/litlfred/smart-base), and links to
what it publishes.

The general pages belong to the FHIR IG layer, and they win where this page
disagrees with them:

- [Render an IG from the command line](https://litlfred.github.io/folio-assistant/fhir-harness/fhir/run-locally.html)
- [Publishing an IG](https://litlfred.github.io/folio-assistant/fhir-harness/fhir/publishing.html)
- [The FHIR IG Publisher](https://litlfred.github.io/folio-assistant/fhir-harness/fhir/ig-publisher.html), §"How the harness runs it"

## What SMART Base adds to the FHIR IG layer
{: #what-smart-base-adds data-fa-label="sec:smart-base-build-what-smart-base-adds" }

[✎ Edit](https://github.com/litlfred/smart-base/edit/main/site-docs/source/guides-smart-base-build/what-smart-base-adds.md){: .fa-node-edit title="Edit site-docs/source/guides-smart-base-build/what-smart-base-adds.md" data-fa-link="edit" data-src="site-docs/source/guides-smart-base-build/what-smart-base-adds.md" data-repo="litlfred/smart-base" } <span class="fa-qa-badges"><button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-block" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="block" data-qa-key="what-smart-base-adds.block" data-qa-label="Content QA" data-qa-noun="block" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/smart-base/guides-smart-base-build/what-smart-base-adds.block.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/smart-base/guides-smart-base-build/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Content QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Content QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">QA</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button> <button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-translation" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="translation" data-qa-key="what-smart-base-adds.translation" data-qa-label="Translation QA" data-qa-noun="block" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/smart-base/guides-smart-base-build/what-smart-base-adds.translation.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/smart-base/guides-smart-base-build/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Translation QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Translation QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">TR</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button></span>

| Step | Checkout script | When it runs | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| DAK pre-processing | `smart-base:dak-pre-export` (`smart-base/scripts/dak-pre-export.sh`) | **before** the Publisher, as the `pre-export:` of `ig-ast-refresh.yml` | runs the WHO scripts in `input/scripts/` (`generate_dak_from_sushi.py`, `update_sushi_config.py`, and, for an IG that declares `contentTypes.dak`, `dmn_questionnaire_generator.py`, `transform_dmn.py` and `inject_translations.py`) in a Python venv |
| DAK API sidecars | `ig-site:sidecars` (`smart-base/scripts/ig-site-sidecars.ts`) | **after** the AST is restored, when smart-base is the IG's `site.landing` | writes the API sidecars from the AST, labelled "DAK API" when the IG declares `contentTypes.dak`; the FHIR IG layer binds them to the artefact pages |

The WHO template comes in the same way: the caller passes
`template-repos: who.template.root=WorldHealthOrganization/smart-ig-template`.
Nothing else differs from the FHIR IG layer's route.

## Render it from the command line
{: #run-it-locally data-fa-label="sec:smart-base-build-run-it-locally" }

From a checkout of `litlfred/smart-base`, mount the layers that
`index.lock.json` pins (the commands are on the FHIR IG layer's page,
§"What you need installed"), then:

```bash
# See what would be built and where
bun run cat stage:local --repo . --plan

# Build the site and compose the publish commit; push nothing
bun run cat stage:local --repo . --dry-run

# Or write a bundle you can open as a page
bun run cat stage:local --repo . --artifact ./_preview
```

The render restores the AST from the cache branch
`cat/fhir-harness/fhir-ast/smart.who.int.base`, which already holds one.

**When the AST is stale** (you changed `input/`, `sushi-config.yaml` or
`ig.ini`), rebuild it with the DAK pre-processing by starting the
repository's **IG AST refresh** workflow (`.github/workflows/ig-ast-refresh.yml`)
on your branch. Running `bun run cat prepare:fhir-harness` on your machine
builds an AST **without** the DAK pre-processing, because that script does not
run a `pre-export` step. Use it only to check that the FSH compiles.

To run the DAK pre-processing on its own, for example to inspect what it
writes: `bun run cat smart-base:dak-pre-export`. It changes files under
`input/`; restore them with `git checkout -- input sushi-config.yaml` before
you commit.

This repository keeps the files of the stock WHO build, which runs the IG
Publisher with no harness:

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `./_updatePublisher.sh` | downloads the **latest** `publisher.jar`, so the version floats |
| `./_genonce.sh` | runs the Publisher once over the IG; the HTML is in `output/` |
| `./_gencontinuous.sh` | runs it again on every change |

In CI the same build is `.github/workflows/ghbuild.yml`: six DAK
pre-processing steps, the Publisher, then nine post-processing steps that
write the DAK API, the JSON Schemas and the JSON-LD vocabularies.
`bun run cat stage:local --repo . --bare-ig` publishes that output as it is.

Use this route to compare with WHO's own build. The harnessed site above is
what this repository publishes.

## The publishing pipeline
{: #publishing data-fa-label="sec:smart-base-build-publishing" }

[✎ Edit](https://github.com/litlfred/smart-base/edit/main/site-docs/source/guides-smart-base-build/publishing.md){: .fa-node-edit title="Edit site-docs/source/guides-smart-base-build/publishing.md" data-fa-link="edit" data-src="site-docs/source/guides-smart-base-build/publishing.md" data-repo="litlfred/smart-base" } <span class="fa-qa-badges"><button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-block" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="block" data-qa-key="publishing.block" data-qa-label="Content QA" data-qa-noun="block" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/smart-base/guides-smart-base-build/publishing.block.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/smart-base/guides-smart-base-build/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Content QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Content QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">QA</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button> <button type="button" class="fa-qa-badge fa-qa-pending fa-qa-fam-translation" lang="en" dir="ltr" data-qa-family="translation" data-qa-key="publishing.translation" data-qa-label="Translation QA" data-qa-noun="block" data-qa-src="{{ '/assets/qa/smart-base/guides-smart-base-build/publishing.translation.json' | relative_url }}" data-qa-index="{{ '/assets/qa/smart-base/guides-smart-base-build/qa-index.json' | relative_url }}" aria-expanded="false" aria-busy="true" title="Translation QA: loading the verdict…" aria-label="Translation QA: loading the verdict…"><span class="fa-qa-tag">TR</span><span class="fa-qa-glyph" aria-hidden="true">…</span></button></span>

Every workflow here is **started by hand** from the Actions tab. Nothing
publishes on push.

| Workflow | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`ig-ast-refresh.yml`](https://github.com/litlfred/smart-base/blob/main/.github/workflows/ig-ast-refresh.yml) | calls the FHIR IG layer's reusable refresh, with `pre-export: bash smart-base/scripts/dak-pre-export.sh` and the WHO template. Seeds the AST cache from `main` |
| [`site-publish.yml`](https://github.com/litlfred/smart-base/blob/main/.github/workflows/site-publish.yml) | mounts the layers and runs `stage-local.ts --repo .`. On `main` it publishes the `gh-pages` root; on another branch, `branches/<branch>/` |
| [`pr-preview.yml`](https://github.com/litlfred/smart-base/blob/main/.github/workflows/pr-preview.yml) | a pull request preview, deployed after a collaborator approves it in the `pr-preview` environment |
| [`ghbuild.yml`](https://github.com/litlfred/smart-base/blob/main/.github/workflows/ghbuild.yml) | the plain WHO build (above) |
| [`release.yml`](https://github.com/litlfred/smart-base/blob/main/.github/workflows/release.yml) | checks `publication-request.json` for a release |

The `gh-pages` root publish also keeps `ns/`, `0.1.0/` and `sitepreview/`
(`site.build.keep` in `index.config.json`): the JSON-LD context and
vocabulary that `publish-context.yml` writes.

SMART Base deploys to **GitHub Pages** only. The options, and what each would
take, are on the FHIR IG layer's page:
[Deployment targets: GitHub Pages and Cloudflare](https://litlfred.github.io/folio-assistant/fhir-harness/fhir/publishing.html#deployment-targets).

Two points are particular to this IG:

- **The canonical is `http://smart.who.int/base`.** It names WHO's
  publication, not this site, so moving this site to another host or domain
  does not change the canonical. It does change every link to
  `litlfred.github.io/smart-base/` that is already published.
- **The site is large**, with six languages and an OpenAPI page per
  operation. Count the files on `gh-pages` before choosing Cloudflare Pages,
  which limits the number of files per deployment.
